highlights.title: Apple reportedly cut more than 200 jobs across Vision Pro and Siri software teams
highlights.description: Apple has laid off employees in its Vision Pro and Siri teams as it shifts focus to smart glasses and next-gen AI tech.

highlights.title: Japanese space tech startup Letara expands beyond satellite thrusters with $16M
highlights.description: Japanese space startup Letara is betting its hybrid rocket technology can move beyond small satellite thrusters into a broader market for space, defense and security, after raising ¥2.6 billion ($16 million).
